doc: Veniccio (g03), the second Georama town by the sea. It plays the first sight of the sea (event 402) and the chase toward the sea (event 404), shows hints for pending Luna Lab rebuilding events, and has the exits to Veniccio Station (s09), Pau's House (s27), the Ocean's Roar Cave dungeon (stage 3) and the red gate to Luna Lab (f03).
